description: The standalone-service notice ("This is an agent and integration service. Open Pardner with pardner open.") does not say that `pardner open` starts a different local client with its own projects, so this service's tasks will not appear there.
expected: "…Open Pardner with `pardner open`. That opens your local client, which keeps its own projects; tasks in this service are not shown there."
actual: Notice implies the board will show this service's data.

description: `pardner serve` prints ~10 emoji-prefixed debug lines (including a stale CORS allowlist for localhost:5174) to stdout before its JSON result, unlike the `client` commands, and port clashes come out as raw `EADDRINUSE: listen EADDRINUSE…`.
expected: JSON result only on stdout (logs to stderr), and PORT_IN_USE wording consistent with the client.
actual: Mixed log lines and JSON; raw EADDRINUSE.
suggested_fix: Route startup logs to stderr; map EADDRINUSE to PORT_IN_USE.
